headline: How CME’s New 24/7 Gold and Single-Stock Futures Push Will Impact CME Group (CME) Investors
summary: CME Group reported its second-quarter 2026 results in the past week, with revenue of US$1,706.2 million and net income of US$1,041.8 million, alongside updated share repurchase activity under its 2024 buyback program. At the same time, CME expanded its product lineup with cash-settled single-stock futures and 24/7 1-ounce Gold futures, aiming to capture around-the-clock, retail-focused trading demand through its Globex platform and retail broker partnerships.
